how: We read the website of every Nashville wedding photographer listed on Lazo (75 listings, 56 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: headshot and corporate studios, boudoir studios, family and senior portrait photographers, a photo-and-marketing agency, and an Ohio studio with no Nashville presence. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: How do you handle the harsh midday light and summer humidity at an outdoor farm ceremony, and have you shot my venue before?
Is a second shooter included, and what is the delivery timeline for the full gallery?
Can I see one complete wedding gallery, start to finish, rather than a highlight reel?

picks.name: Nicole Lenia Kiser Imagery
picks.blurb: Nicole Lenia Kiser is a documentary-style elopement and wedding photographer who pairs landscape photography with storytelling, and shoots Super 8 film as well. Based in Nashville, she has photographed and filmed couples in over 25 states and two countries.

picks.name: Nashville Photography Group
picks.blurb: A studio founded and led by Jeb Wilson, who has over 18 years in the industry. Nashville Photography Group packages include two professional photographers, an engagement session and a print credit, and the site lists awards from The Knot and WeddingWire.

picks.name: Melanie Dunn Photography
picks.blurb: Melanie Dunn photographs luxury weddings in Nashville and Sun Valley, Idaho, and travels for destinations as far as a chateau in the French countryside. Based in Hendersonville, with a focus on authentic emotion and images with a story to tell.

picks.name: Justin Wright Photography
picks.blurb: Justin Wright's approach is to know when to step in and when to step back, for couples who do not want a photographer taking over the day or turning every moment into a performance. A Nashville wedding photographer with couples' own words featured on the site.

picks.name: Brody Hall Photography
picks.blurb: After more than 35 years as a professional, Brody Hall has photographed thousands of weddings and events along with sports, celebrities and assignments at the White House and Pentagon. Based in Murfreesboro, and his pricing page speaks frankly about cost.

picks.name: With This Ring Wedding Films + Photo
picks.blurb: With This Ring does wedding films and photos from one team, with 20 years and more than 500 weddings behind it and features in Vogue and Brides. Nashville based, travels everywhere, and every collection is customizable.

picks.name: Maria Gloer Photography
picks.blurb: Maria Gloer shoots digital and film for elegant, refined couples, drawing on fine art and the soft look of film photography. Nine years of love stories out of Hendersonville, also available to travel worldwide; she photographs newborns as well.

picks.name: Greg and Jess Photography and Videography
picks.blurb: Greg and Jess are a Nolensville couple who met in Australia, where Greg is from, and now shoot weddings as photographers and videographers. Parents of two girls, and the site mentions a free engagement session offer worth asking about.

picks.name: Nikki Boros Photography
picks.blurb: Nikki Boros has been a professional photographer for 10 years and has photographed more than 200 weddings, in a style she calls bright, colorful and authentic. A Colorado transplant working out of Smyrna, with a price page organized by type of session.

picks.name: Ashley Holstein Photography, LLC
picks.blurb: Ashley Holstein calls herself a visual storyteller for artful souls and says she became a photographer to capture the unexpected. Organic, timeless images for weddings and sessions, based in Hendersonville.

picks.name: Laura K. Allen Photography & Design
picks.blurb: Laura K. Allen is a Nashville wedding and engagement photographer who travels near and far to document love stories, in a style she describes as romantic, timeless and classic.

picks.name: Cody Harris – Cinematic Wedding Photographer
picks.blurb: Cody Harris offers photography and film shaped by how the wedding actually feels, paying attention to the inside jokes and the tender, chaotic moments as much as the portraits. Nashville, West Coast and destination.
